fee_notes: $45,000 for both start-up and re-sale warehouses. Incentive programs may waive or reduce fee. FY2024 fees ranged $0-$45,000. Additional pre-opening required fees: equipment/supplies $5,000-$10,000; Opening Marketing Package $30,000; initial inventory $250,000-$800,000 (all non-refundable).
raw_excerpt: When you sign the Franchise Agreement, you must pay to us an initial fee of $45,000 (the "Initial Franchise Fee") for your Warehouse. The Initial Franchise Fee is non-refundable. In the fiscal year ended December 28, 2024, we received Initial Franchise Fees ranging from $0 to $45,000 from franchisees.
